title: Elite: The Crowd Names the Trial: First Pressure
description: The Crowd Names the Trial unfolds across floating marble arena with bronze laurel circles and crowd-shadow platforms, pushing a one active Titan Olympian Titan to prove elite balanced pressure, precision, dueling, morale momentum. without violating established Realm canon.
